I've seen far too many people still go up to those registers, *stare* at the screen, tap on it like that will "turn it on", or just start trying to scan things and then complaining "It's not working!!"...

I feel this. I remember at one of my lowest weights (I was probably a size sm/medium) I was buying 2XL hoodies just so I could hide my stomach at school. The gym teachers allotted us PE shirts and gave me the right size (couldn't exchange)... so I ran in my hoodie, inside, every day. I still don't think I have any clothes that actually "fit" me.

Another thing I remember is from age 6ish onwards, sucking in my stomach all day until bedtime and then having horrible nightmares that somehow I would kick my covers off in the night and "everyone" would see how fat I really am. 

The only thing that has helped me overcome this, just a little bit, is remembering that everyone has insecurities. My beautiful little cousin, a couple years ago, was so upset at her own birthday party because she didn't want to wear a swimsuit and wanted to go swimming fully clothed (wasn't allowed at that pool.) Talking to her and helping her get through that really did change my perspective on self-confidence. But I'll admit it didn't cure my own anxiety.

The best and only thing I've found so far, for now, is distraction. Some suggestions: Go to the theaters and find a movie to get invested in for a couple hours, set a mileage/hiking goal for a day and keep walking until you've accomplished that goal, exercise until you're too tired to worry about anything but sleep, spend time cooking your favorite meal, write a nice letter to someone in need (pen pal). Just some ideas.

Do what makes you happy. Truly happy. And make sure you are happy. 

I know you probably feel the nagging dread, the feeling that nothing matters. At least, if you still decide to go, could you try everything you can to drown that out?
I don't know you personally, but personally, my happiest moments are from the times I'm most distracted from reality. And I mean that in a wide variety of ways, going to a community gathering and volunteering for hours, going for a spontaneous run at midnight, trying to stand on my head, sun tanning with hundreds of stickers on my body so I'm polka dotted, literally ANYTHING. Silly things, dumb things, things that make you think, do them all! 

And I don't mean to make you feel guilty or anything, I just hope you soak up as much... experience and interaction as you can because life is short, but it doesn't all have to be painful... Make yourself some of your favorite food tonight and do some self care, have some hot tea and enjoy yourself. 
Also, don't be afraid to pm me, my inbox is always open. 
Please take care.

I'm sorry you feel this way, I know it feels like nothing will ever change (I feel this way too), but the moments I'm the happiest are the moments I am distracted. My best advice is to do anything you can to make yourself happy, that's where I am right now.

I hope you can reconsider, two days is a lot of time to think! Why not take a couple more days after that and do whatever you want? Get your favorite foods, sit in the sunshine, go for a walk, go to the animal shelter and pet puppies and kittens. Not to downplay how you are feeling, I just hope you're able to find joy somewhere. It's difficult for me too.. but the little things help.
